item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
What's new

  • Updates now arrive by themselves: your pet tells you when a new version is ready, one click installs it.
  • ClickUp dates can go into your Apple Calendar, one way and without duplicates (Settings, Connected Apps).
  • Code tab: start new chats without picking a folder, choose the Claude model, copy replies and save chats.
